instruction: Records are consolidated requested behaviors; NOT proof of code implementation, testing or release. Verify source PR and exact user conversation before any claim. Privacy-review any conversational export to public GitHub.

records.acceptance: Keep native Kaffeine Next TV channel list, scan, EPG, subtitles, Teletext and channel switching without feature loss.
Fix channel scan crash, weak-signal handling, PAT/PMT/HEVC issues, old PID/audio/video state when switching.
Maintain real RF SNR, quality, frequency, signal strength and scan progress (no invented telemetry).
Fix TV/radio/TV transition crashes and exclusive SDR/DVB device handoff with hard stop.
Ensure fullscreen video hides unnecessary bottom bars and preserves playback controls.
Keep native TV functionality and native desktop RF input without requiring browser WebUSB.
Keep teletext pages/subtitle source selection; compare with spoken dialogue and auto-fallback to Whisper on mismatch.
Prevent caption settings/dialog or channel switching from hiding current subtitles, retaining old program PIDs or blocking live playback.
Keep TV buffered caption timing stable with enough read-ahead, visible offset and easy-read modes.
Show all DAB multiplex blocks by default; scan ensembles and stations, with searchable favorites/channel lists.
Support DLS/DLS+, Journaline, MOT slideshow navigation and genuine live spectrum/waterfall and quality widgets.
Wait for actual welle-cli API readiness/dynamically selected port; show process/USB/decoder errors and avoid infinite loading.
Support FM RDS/RadioText and searchable online/radio station sources, analog tuning where supported.
Maintain LW/MW/SW/AM/FM feature choices without inventing unsupported frequencies or demodulators.
Prevent radio AI subtitles from stopping/restarting, long expanding buffers, repeating/transcription drift, duplicate provider lines.
When radio fails, recover only resources owned by Media Center, never kill user's external readsb/tar1090 services.
Expose separate Internet Load / Radio Load, device lease and source details; keep radio/TV fast transition progress.
Use one live caption timeline and apply user offset once per segment, never again as reading delay.
Keep spoken words visible even if sound labels [music]/[noise]/TESTSEITE or lyric matching is active; labels may use separate lines.
Show original spoken text even when optional translation model, Whisper or source fails.
Keep independent TV/radio captions, DVB Teletext, DAB DLS, Whisper and lyrics source attribution and no duplicated captions.
Maintain optimized easy readability, punctuation and natural chunk boundaries with adjustable font/background/opacity/position.
Support selectable source language Auto Detect; default English output; optional Whisper speech→English→configured translation model target pipeline.
Keep direct translation options (such as DE→TR) and installed model inventory Argos/NLLB/MADLAD/other model readiness without imaginary capability.
Preserve optional speaker labeling and experimental two-speaker overlap separation without allowing failed separation to block ordinary dialogue.
Keep adjustable transcription/subtitle delay and buffer policy; audio/video should not drift because of additive repeated waits.
Distinguish truly available CPU/GPU/NPU backends from simply detected RTX 5080; support fail-safe fallback and optional paired remote GPU.
Separate karaoke lipsync from Whisper speech lipsync and subtitle easy-read pacing.
Show LYRICS FOUND distinct from LYRICS MATCHED and allow user-configured confidence thresholds.
Provide opt-in lyrics-found preview playback highlighting at lower confidence, clearly marked as estimated.
Use installed Qwen forced-aligner where available; fallback to Whisper; never infer a match solely from web lyric lookup.
Stop karaoke progress during instrumental/no-vocals and resume at verified sung words rather than clock-based auto-scroll.
Fix Lyrics Refresh, Full Lyrics and separate floating blue lyrics window; matched word highlighted and optional yellow translation.
Refresh sync from retained recent buffer, not entire growing buffer; allow separately adjustable ~10-second karaoke offset.
Preserve lyric sources, legal provider policy, song continuity/metadata cache and transcription when matched lyrics unavailable.
Keep single embedded media player: video shares TV settings and audio shares radio settings; do not spawn extra playback windows.
Offer optional full-file transcription before playing local audio/video, then replay with completed captions.
Preserve live and offline timed transcripts with TXT/SRT/VTT/ASS/JSON and supported verified LRC exports; distinguish complete from live.
Preserve TV/radio recording/export, selected subtitle/audio tracks, optional MKV or rendered MP4 subtitle behavior and never overwrite original recordings.
Keep separate Start/Stop and Exit; Stop releases own receiver while leaving window and user's external services intact.
Preserve legacy rollback, main/PR references, one-line cross-platform installer and user settings on updates.
Keep genuine ADS-B/Mode-S via readsb and optional internet, with I/R/I-R attribution and per-ICAO deduplication.
Keep internet providers separate (adsb.lol, adsb.fi, OpenSky and policy-gated sources) with independent layer selection and rate limits.
Use the real upstream tar1090 view and license attribution, not a lookalike; function even without antenna with real internet traffic.
Keep Köln default, map drag, nearest-aircraft focus, receiver focus, fit/follow, icons, legends, mobile list and popups.
Provide genuine departure/arrival route, origin/destination/time when a verified radio or internet source supplies it; unknown otherwise.
Show separate Radio Load and Internet Load, receiver/pairing status and correct hard stop semantics; do not claim SD R when missing.
Preserve geographic country/region/city search DE/TR and saved location/manual coordinates, with offline fallback.
Keep aircraft detail overlays, multiple selected model layers, natural resize, controls not covering overlays.
RF On enables/disables localization only, not ADS-B/Internet tracking; optional Location Circles default on with RF.
Keep independent Aircraft/Location/LIVE Fit/BEST Fit circles, persistence/recomputation and explicitly labeled uncertainty.
Use true received packets and honest horizon/PSF/Gaussian bounds; do not invent precise TOA/MLAT location from one SDR.
Keep incremental bounded History, cache and performance limits, original evidence timestamps.
Protect legacy/v0.3.1 and current releases, pinned versions and one-line restore path; reconcile open Draft PR #7 and #13.
Keep native RTL-SDR/readsb separate from optional browser WebUSB and never stop externally managed services.
Keep canonical standalone Pages and Text Center-generated mirror in source-SHA sync; verify both after any rename.
Add feature/component/model/developer-agent matrices, root CLAUDE.md and DeepSeek guide to Flight Radar's own repo.
Carry own PR history plus original Text Center source links and history gaps by immutable GitHub repository IDs.
Keep TLE orbital predictions, AOS/LOS/max elevation, Earth and sky maps, selected station and horizon orientation such as 280°.
Offer best-pass/near-zenith planning and scheduled recording, optional alerts; verify local time zones and device readiness.
Support ISS SSTV/Robot36 WAV and concurrent IQ when possible; NOAA APT; Meteor M2-3/M2-4 LRPT IQ workflows.
Handle long RF captures and browser recording segment limits without losing frames, bytes or source time.
Report empty CADU, analog telemetry missing, PLL unlock, unsupported decoder, zero-image output instead of claiming images.
Keep wideband satellite/ham frequencies, amateur CubeSats, Iridium and per-pass capture profiles as supported, not invented.
Keep SDR native desktop hardware, exclusive lease, Start/Stop, automatic decode/export ZIP/audio/visual products when verified.
Keep exact IQ/sample-rate/frequency metadata, offline TLE/map planning and source provenance.
Preserve independent geolocation app, not only Flight Radar embedded UI; own positioning APIs and tests.
Support GNSS/NMEA, radio observations, aircraft evidence, valid TDOA/multilateration when hardware timestamps allow.
Expose PSF/Gaussian models, statistical uncertainty and source/provenance rather than fake precise coordinates.
Support large-circle performance optimization, indexing, incremental fit and bounded history.
Show source aircraft coverage rings separately from Location, LIVE Fit and BEST Fit positioning rings.
RF On enables real localized computation with optional location circle default, RF Off stops own radio computation.
Provide multiple independent map/model layers, offline maps, saved coordinate selection and map interaction.
Do not require latitude/longitude user input for verified RF 3+ aircraft region-estimation mode.
Keep Text Center as active canonical source in TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER, including textcenter/ and web/ paths.
FM RDS/RadioText+, DAB DLS/DLS+, Journaline, MOT slideshow, full scans and genuine frequency/source information.
DVB-T2 scan, channel list, Teletext, playback, live subtitles, selected channels and recording metadata remain intact.
Keep optional NOAA APT, AIS, ACARS, RTL-433 modules truthful about hardware capability and decoding state.
Offer independent device manager, native RF desktop operation, hard stop and default on-demand/no-background lifecycle.
Preserve local web desktop/tablet/mobile parity, saved favorites, source selection and responsive navigation.
Continue Text Center development after other app cutovers, retaining original historical PR archive and code provenance.
Protect existing Pages/PWA/installer URLs against a later explicitly approved rename of the SAME repository ID.
ZERO application feature, behavior, default, settings, recordings, data, installer, device ownership or existing icon changes in audit phase.
English engineering internals, source docs, commits, GitHub Issue/PR and coding-agent prompts; UI languages English(default), Turkish, German in all five apps.
Only use exact five previously approved red/black/white TIHULU mascot logo PNG masters; verify hashes and real SVG later.
Three user-created empty repos are Media, Satellite, RF Geolocation; Text Center stays in source repo, Flight Radar remains separate canonical.
No loss of PR comments, reviews, issue timelines, decisions, original author/time: linked old repo + explicit transfer gaps + independent permitted snapshots.
On any future origin repo rename, preserve original GitHub URLs and repo ID; resolve aliases, test Pages/PWA, GitHub raw scripts, workflow and PR links.
Document FEATURE, COMPONENT, MODEL and DEVELOPMENT_AGENT matrices for each app in its canonical repository, with Claude/DeepSeek navigation.
Six independent audit workers coordinate through GitHub Issues, distinct branches and Draft PRs; no shared file edits or unapproved merges.
Only verified source-backed test success is reported as success; distinguish unit/static CI from real NooElec/Hauppauge physical tests.
Preserve main, all prior Draft PRs (#65–#74), Flight Radar PRs (#7/#13), open issues, legacy rollback and active installed apps.
Set explicit user authorization gates for first commits to empty repos, importing sources, icon activation, merges, release repoints and renames.
Track progress from audited counts and tested gates; remaining hours/minutes stay null until workload is inventoried and assumptions documented.
Treat optional paired GPU remote processing, offline-first CPU/GPU/NPU support, models and permissions as modular nonbreaking future changes.
Keep separate related Survival Kit News/Emergency/AI requirements inventory without silently grafting them onto these five apps.
For each demand distinguish Requested, Draft coded, Verified in CI, Verified on device, Released; never promote from code presence alone.
